confidenceStates.verified: FormID, EditorID, source plugin and repeat behaviour confirmed against the local game files by AuditQuests.pas. Only the audit script may write this value.
confidenceStates.likely: Strong evidence from public documentation and quest behaviour, but not yet confirmed against local records. Tagged by default.
confidenceStates.unverified: Listed for completeness. NOT tagged unless ALLOW_UNVERIFIED is enabled in the generator.
confidenceStates.excluded: Reviewed and deliberately left untagged. Never written to a plugin.

fieldNotes.formID: Load-order-independent FormID within sourcePlugin, hex string. null until the audit resolves it.
fieldNotes.editorID: Preferred match key. null until the audit resolves it.
fieldNotes.originalName: Fallback match key. May contain text-replacement tokens such as <Alias=Workshop>.
fieldNotes.module: Which output plugin the override lands in. Modules are disjoint - a quest appears in exactly one.
fieldNotes.evidence: Why this quest is classified the way it is (spec section 13).
